english: passport: an official document used to travel between countries.
persian: passport یعنی گذرنامه؛ مدرک رسمی سفر بین کشورها.

english: boarding pass: the document that shows your flight and seat and lets you board.
persian: boarding pass یعنی کارت پرواز که اطلاعات پرواز و صندلی روی آن است.
examples: Your gate is on the boarding pass.
I have a mobile boarding pass.

english: fare: the money you pay for a bus, train, or taxi journey.
persian: fare یعنی کرایه‌ی اتوبوس، قطار یا تاکسی.
examples: The taxi fare is twenty dollars.

english: order: to ask for food or drink in a restaurant.
persian: order به‌عنوان فعل یعنی سفارش دادن غذا یا نوشیدنی.

english: receipt: a paper or digital record showing what you paid for.
persian: receipt یعنی رسید خرید یا پرداخت.

english: available: free or ready to be used, bought, or seen.
persian: available یعنی در دسترس یا موجود.
